documents.markdown:
# Account recovery

Reset a forgotten password using the recovery link on the sign-in page. The password reset link expires after 30 minutes.

# Refund policy

Annual subscriptions are refundable within 14 days of purchase. Monthly subscriptions are not refundable.

# Invoices

Workspace administrators can download invoices from Settings > Billing > Invoices. Invoices are generated at the start of each billing period.

# API limits

The query API allows 60 requests per minute per IP address. Exceeding the limit returns HTTP 429. Wait before retrying.

# Document deletion

Deleting a document also deletes its indexed chunks. Ingestion audit history is retained. Delete a source using its stable source key.

# Ingestion retries

If embedding fails, the previous document version stays available. Retry an import by running the ingestion command again. Identical documents are skipped.
